text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, City!!
You looked so, so pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Truly... I'll never forget today's run.
Never...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're the most beautiful of all, City!!
*sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Were you able to run your heart out?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Anyone watching could tell, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's okay to say it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The current me.
The me who ran through the mud, ran, and won.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: How does it look through your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You know, I'm gonna keep running from now on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No matter what anyone says or how they look at me, it doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running, staying beautiful the whole way.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Because I've decided that running is who 'I' truly am!"
